replies.author: Wavertron
replies.body:
It's really not.

From the consumer angle, the backlash is due to massive quantities of low quality games. You can see this recently with the last Steam Next Fest.

From the developer, the backlash is due to many concerns, including their skillsets being made obsolete, their own games losing visibility in the flood of games, their own games being copied, just to name a few.

This isn't brainwashing, propaganda and has nothing to do with China v US.

This is pure market behaviour.

You should delete your Reddit post.
